title: OrderStatusChanged
description: Published by Click and Collect when a store fulfillment changes state. Two event types share this topic and are distinguished by the Event-Type message attribute: ORDER_STATUS_CHANGED carries the status transition, ORDER_PICKUP_DATETIME_CHANGED carries a moved, set or cleared pickup time. A message matches exactly one of the two shapes below. Messages are ordered on fulfillmentId, and the Order-Type attribute is always CUSTOMER_ORDER or STORE_TRANSFER.

orderId.description: Id of the customer order the fulfillment belongs to

fulfillmentId.description: Id of the store fulfillment whose status changed. Also the ordering key of the message

businessUnitId.description: Id of the business unit fulfilling the order

previousStatus.description: Status the fulfillment held before the change. Absent when no previous status was recorded

newStatus.description: Status the fulfillment holds after the change

changedBy.description: User profile id of whoever caused the change. Absent when the change had no user identity

changedAt.description: Time the status change was applied. Required: it is the ordering-guard source for consumers of this topic

orderType.description: Type of the order, mirroring the Order-Type message attribute

orderLines.description: Order lines carried with the transition. Absent on transitions that do not carry line detail

OrderPickupDatetimeChangedEvent.description: Payload sent with Event-Type ORDER_PICKUP_DATETIME_CHANGED. Every key is always present; the two instants are null when the write cleared the pickup time

orderId.description: Id of the customer order the fulfillment belongs to

fulfillmentId.description: Id of the store fulfillment whose pickup time changed. Also the ordering key of the message

businessUnitId.description: Id of the business unit fulfilling the order

pickupDatetime.description: Pickup time after the write. Null when the write cleared it

urgentFromDatetime.description: Datetime from which the order counts as urgent, derived from pickupDatetime and the tenant urgency threshold. Null when pickupDatetime is null

modifiedDatetime.description: Value written to orders.modified_datetime by the write that moved the pickup time

OrderStatusChangedOrderLine.description: One order line carried with a status transition

itemId.description: Id of the item on the order line

substitutions.description: Substituted items picked against this line. Always present, empty when there are none

OrderStatusChangedSubstitution.description: One substituted item picked against an order line

itemIdentifier.description: Identifier of the substituted item as scanned

quantity.description: Quantity picked of the substituted item

unitOfMeasure.description: Unit of measure the quantity is expressed in
